data.title: King Abdulaziz University Ranks First in Saudi Arabia, Arab World in QS Sustainability Rankings 2027
data.content:
Jeddah, November 19, 2026, SPA -- King Abdulaziz University has achieved a new milestone in global rankings, placing first among Saudi and Arab universities in the QS World University Rankings: Sustainability 2027 and securing 166th place globally. The university advanced 28 positions from the previous year, earning an overall score of 87.8 points, reflecting improvements in its institutional performance in environmental and social sustainability and governance.
    The rankings are based on three main pillars: Environmental Impact, accounting for 45%; Social Impact, also accounting for 45%; and Governance, accounting for 10%. The university achieved strong results in several sub-indicators, reflecting the integration of its academic, research, and institutional efforts to support sustainability.
    This progress highlights King Abdulaziz University's standing and role in advancing the Sustainable Development Goals across environmental, social, and institutional dimensions. Its contributions include scientific research and innovation, human capacity development, support for health, well-being, and quality of life, and the promotion of sound governance practices. These efforts enhance the university's development impact and international competitiveness, in line with the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030.
    -- SPA
